Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Qualifying Requirement of 1.1 This invitation for bid is open to all company/LLP incorporated in I the Bidder ndia under Companies Act, 1956 and Companies Act 2013, Propriet orship firm and includes Government owned Enterprises and does n ot include foreign bidders/MNCs not registered and incorporated in I ndia and those companies with whom business is banned by the Ow ner. The Qualification of bidder will be based on meeting the minim um pass/fail criteria specified below on standalone basis. 1.2 Technical Qualifying Requirement: Unless otherwise specif ically mentioned in the Bid Data Sheet (BDS), the bidder shoul d have following Technical Qualifying requirement; a. Bidder should be a company registered under companies Act 1956/20 13, Proprietorship firm. b. .Manufacturer Base: The Bidder should be a manufacturer of the te ndered equipment/ materials and should have its own manufacturing faciliti

es in INDIA. c. Minimum Offer Quantity: The minimum quantity to be offered by t he bidder shall not be less than 50% of the tender quantity for any of the Su bstation Supply items and not less than 30% of the tender quantity for any of the Line Supply Items. If the quantity offered by the bidder is less than 5 0%/30%, their bid shall be rejected out rightly. d. Supply Experience: The Bidder shall demonstrate that it has succes sfully supplied the Equipment/Materials of same or higher standard/size of at least 100% of the quantity offered in the tender to any Transmission/ Ge neration/Distribution Utility in any State/Central/ or any CPSU/PSU or any T ransmission Licensee awarded with Transmission Project under Tariff Base d Competitive Bidding (TBCB) process in India during last 5(Five) years reck oned from the Original schedule date of submission of bid, so as to meet th e Supply Experience qualifying criteria. However, if the company exists for l ess than five years, it shall demonstrate minimum supply experience of 20 % of the quantity offered per year of existence within one to four years. e. Operational Experience: The Offered equipment/materials should have at least one year proven trouble free operational service in tropical cli mate as on Original schedule date of Bid opening. The bidder shall furnish e vidence in the form of certificate from Power utilities that the equipment/m aterials supplied by them have been performing satisfactorily. The bid shall be accompanied by user’s performance certificate from Transmission/ Gene ration Utility in any State/Central/ or any CPSU/PSU or any Transmission Lic ensee awarded with Transmission Project under Tariff Based Competitive Bi dding (TBCB) process in India in support of satisfactory performance of thei r above equipment/materials supplied earlier. f. Testing Facility: The Bidder must have all necessary testing facilities at their own factory for carrying out routine and acceptance tests as prescribe d in the relevant ISS and any other test as specified in the technical specifi cation (Volume-II). g. Type Test Requirement: The equipment/materials shall have Valid Type Test Report conducted at the Accredited Laboratory of repute such as CPRI/EREDA/ NABL Accredited Labs. Such Type of Test Reports (TTRs) shall remain valid for the period mentioned in the CEA Guidelines as adopted by UPPTCL from time to time recko ned from the original date of opening. Bids not accompanied with type test reports conducted during the period mention in of BDS o f the offered Equipment/Materials duly approved by the Type Testi ng Agency shall not be considered for evaluation. The type test port of their principal can also be accepted subject to the guarant ee period of 54 months form date of supply or 48 months from dat e of commissioning whichever is earlier. h. Guaranteed Technical Particulars: The Equipment/Materials shall meet the minimum guaranteed Technical Particulars specified in the Volum e-II of this tender. 1.3 Financial Qualifying Requirement: Unless otherwise specifically mentioned in the Bid Data Sheet (BDS), the bidde r should have following Financial Qualifying requirement; a. Turnover: The Minimum Average Annual Turnover (MAAT) of the Bid der shall be at least 2 times of the estimated cost of the tender. In case the bidder offers the minimum quantity, the MAAT of the bidder shall be reduce d to that extent. For the purpose of calculation of MAAT, Average of the Bes t Three Financial Years Turnover out of the Last Five Financial Years precedi ng to the year of NIT shall be considered. In case the Bidder is in existence

for less than five financial years the Minimum Average Annual Turnover sha ll be average of the turnover of the completed no of financial years. The tur nover of the bidding company shall be on standalone basis only (excluding its Associate companies/Holding Company) duly certified by the Chartered Accountant/Cost Accountant firm. b. Bid Capacity: The bid capacity of the bidder shall be considered as s um total of the Value of minimum offered quantity in a single or multiple te nder(s) invited under the NIT less the Value of the purchase orders in hand (not executed as on the date of tender) already issued by the UPPTCL. c. Insolvency Position: The bidder must not have been declared Insolv ent and their cases have not been referred to National Company Law Tribu nal (NCLT). In such a case the bid is liable to be rejected. In this respect bid der shall submit an undertaking towards its insolvency position. 1.4 Certificate/Affidavit :Unless otherwise specifically mentio ned in the Bid Data Sheet (BDS), the bidder should submit the ffidavits /undertaking in respect of; a. Documents: The bidder must upload the signed documents in support of t he above Technical and Financial criteria as per the prescribe d format. b. Legal Dispute: i. The bidder(s) should not have any pending litigation with UPP TCL with regard to any project or related activity. The bidder s hould certify/ declare the same in unequivocal terms by way of an affidavit duly sworn before a Magistrate/ Notary. Bid furnish ed by the bidder shall not be eligible for consideration if it is no t accompanied by the Affidavit. ii. Blacklisting/Debar The bidder(s) shall also disclose if he was black listed/ Debar b y any utility of central /state/PSUs or any Government departm ent in the past and the blacklisting order was subsequently wit hdrawn by the utility suo-moto or set aside by any court order. Detection of the bidder’s non-disclosure of these facts at any stage will lead to rejection of the bid or termination of the cont ract with forfeiture of EMD/ CPBG. c. Acceptance of Technical & Commercial Conditions of the Tend er: The bidder must agree to the guaranteed technical parameters specifie d in Volume-II and shall also accept the commercial terms and conditions of the tender without any deviations. d. The bidder must fulfill the e-tendering process guidelines. e. The bidder must furnish Affidavit in the prescribed format to the effec t that the documents and information furnished by them in its bid offer in r espect of the said tender are true and correct. f. The bidder must submit the qualification data, information and docum ents incomplete shape as per the prescribed guidelines of the official e-ten der portal of the Owner. . 3.
